(1541) Microsoft Dynamics 365 F&SCM Functional Analyst
Nortal
Location: Brazil · 13 hours ago · 1 applicant Promoted by hirer · No response insights available yet
About the job Join Nortal for your next big adventure. We are seeking Microsoft Dynamics 365 F&SCM Functional Analyst to join our team, grow with us, and teach us a few things along the way. Why join Nortal Say Goodbye to Micromanagement: We champion autonomy, open communication, and respect for diversity as our core values. Outcomes Over Hours: We believe in a work model focused on impact, providing you with the flexibility to balance your professional success with your personal well-being. Vibrant Community: Join our close-knit LATAM remote team and connect through tech talks, virtual coffee breaks, and team-building activities. Support from Day One: Our People Care team is here to support you throughout your journey, from wellness check-ins to professional growth. Our benefits ✨ Competitive USD salary. 100% remote work: While you can work from anywhere, you’re always welcome to connect with teammates and grow your network at our coworking spaces across LATAM. Paid time off & national holidays: Take the time you need according to your country’s regulations while receiving your full salary. Sick leave: Focus on your health without stress. Take the necessary time to recover and feel better. Annual credit: Spend it on the perks you love to enhance your work-life balance. Team-building activities: Join us for coffee breaks, tech talks, and after-work gatherings to bond with your Nortal family and feel part of our vibrant community. Birthday off: Enjoy an extra day off during your birthday week to celebrate in style with friends and family. About The Project We're looking for an experienced D365 Finance & Supply Chain Management (F&SCM) Functional Analyst to join a global implementation and stabilization initiative. This is a great fit for someone who enjoys both building new solutions and cleaning up existing ones — you'll work across a multi-country, multi-legal-entity environment, helping the business get the most out of standard D365 functionality while reducing unnecessary customization. What You’ll Do Partner directly with business stakeholders to understand their processes, pain points, and goals Use Microsoft's standard D365 F&SCM functionality as your baseline — performing fit-to-standard and fit-gap analysis to find the best path forward Dig into existing configurations and customizations to understand what they do, why they exist, and whether they're still needed Present clear solution options to stakeholders — including your recommendation, alternatives considered, and the tradeoffs involved Configure D365 F&SCM functionality within your assigned modules, and support the full implementation lifecycle from discovery through go-live and stabilization Create clean, implementation-ready functional documentation — requirements, business rules, process flows, and acceptance criteria Act as the functional bridge between business and technical teams, answering questions throughout design, build, testing, and deployment Coordinate or execute testing, and build reusable test cases to support regression testing and automation (including Playwright-based testing) What Makes You a Great Fit 5+ years of hands-on experience as a D365 F&SCM or Dynamics AX Functional Analyst, Functional Consultant, or similar ERP functional role Demonstrated expertise in one or more D365 F&SCM modules or business process areas Experience across multiple phases of D365 F&SCM implementations — requirements, configuration, testing, deployment, and production support Working knowledge of D365 F&SCM integrations, data entities, workflows, security, reporting, and batch processing Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to explain complex ideas in plain business language A collaborative, personable approach — you're just as comfortable in a stakeholder workshop as you are in a technical design review Global Impact, Local Culture 🌍 For over 25 years, we’ve been shaping digital transformation, delivering complex solutions for global enterprises and public sector organizations. Today, we are at the forefront of an AI-driven transformation era, helping organizations turn data into real business value. By combining deep domain expertise with data and AI, we design solutions that create immediate impact while scaling for the future. We believe complexity doesn’t have to mean complicated, and that the best solutions are those that work in the real world, not just on paper. That’s why our clients trust us with their most ambitious, business-critical initiatives. Apply now and let’s shape the future of technology together! 🧑‍💻 By applying to this position, you authorize Nortal to collect, store, transfer, and process your personal data in accordance with our Privacy Policy. For more information, please review our Privacy Policy.

jobs.description:
Microsoft Dynamics 365 F&O Project Management & Accounting Consultant
BDO Canada
Location: Edmonton, AB · Reposted 6 hours ago · 0 people clicked apply Responses managed off LinkedIn
About the job Putting people first, every day BDO is a firm built on a foundation of positive relationships with our people and our clients. Each day, our professionals provide exceptional service, helping clients with advice and insight they can trust. In turn, we offer an award-winning environment that fosters a people-first culture with a high priority on your personal and professional growth. Your Opportunity BDO Digital is currently looking for a Microsoft Dynamics 365 F&O Project Management & Accounting Consultant to join our growing Dynamics F&O Practice, with the ability to work from anywhere in Canada. This is a new role and the individual will own the following responsibilities: Act as a trusted advisor to external customers and BDO project teams in support of client ERP implementations, with a focus on Dynamics 365 F&O Project Management and Accounting (PMA) Perform a lead PMA consultant role on larger projects where multiple functional consultants are engaged, providing mentorship and guidance to other consultants Analyze customer project-based business models, financial requirements, and operational objectives, and provide in-depth application expertise in Project Management and Accounting Design and implement end-to-end project accounting solutions, including project costing, revenue recognition, billing methods, budgeting, forecasting, and project lifecycle management Streamline customer project governance, financial control, and reporting processes to achieve greater ROI within the Dynamics 365 Finance and Operations, Enterprise Edition suite Collaborate closely with Finance, Supply Chain, Asset Management, and Sales consultants to ensure integrated project-based solutions Support and lead system configuration, testing, data migration, and deployment activities related to Project Management and Accounting Provide training and knowledge transfer to client staff to support day-to-day project management, accounting, and reporting activities How do we define success for your role? You demonstrate BDO's core values through all aspect of your work: Integrity, Respect and Collaboration You understand your client’s industry, challenges, and opportunities; clients describe you as positive, professional, and delivering high-quality work You identify, recommend, and are focused on effective service delivery to your clients You share in an inclusive and engaging work environment that develops, retains & attracts talent You actively participate in the adoption of digital tools and strategies to drive an innovative workplace You grow your expertise through learning and professional development. Your Experience And Education Minimum 3+ years of Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance and Operations / AX consulting experience, with strong expertise in Project Management and Accounting Full-cycle Dynamics 365 F&O implementation experience, including requirements gathering, solution design, configuration, testing, and go-live support Strong understanding of project-based accounting and financial management processes, including: Project costing and budgeting Revenue recognition and billing (fixed price, time and material, milestone-based) Project forecasting and cost control Project lifecycle and governance Experience integrating Project Management and Accounting with Finance, Supply Chain Management, and Asset Management Knowledge of one or more additional functional areas such as Finance, Supply Chain Management, Asset Management, or Manufacturing is preferred Dynamics 365 F&O / AX certifications in Project Management and Accounting, Finance, or related disciplines will be considered in the selection process Self-motivated, articulate, and able to lead discussions and inspire client audiences Strong process analysis, redesign, and documentation experience Why BDO? Our people-first approach to talent has earned us a spot among Canada’s Top 100 Employers for 2026. This recognition is a milestone we’re thrilled to add to our collection of awards for both experienced and student talent experiences. At BDO, our people experience is guided by three core pillars—Do work with genuine care, Do what matters with purpose, and Do what’s next - shaping how we support our people, serve our clients, and grow together. Our firm is committed to providing an environment where you can be successful in the following ways: We enable you to engage with how we change and evolve, being a key contributor to the success and growth of BDO in Canada. We help you become a better professional within our services, industries, and markets with extensive opportunities for learning and development. We support your achievement of personal goals outside of the office and making an impact on your community. We foster a collaborative, inclusive environment where your ideas are valued, and you can do your best work with genuine care and purpose We encourage innovation and forward thinking, empowering you to embrace what’s next and help shape the future of our firm Giving back adds up: Where company meets community. BDO is actively involved in our communities by supporting local charity initiatives. We support staff with local and national events where you will be given the opportunity to contribute to your community. Total rewards that matter: We pay for performance with competitive total cash compensation that recognizes and rewards your contribution. We provide comprehensive benefits from day one, and a flexible personal time off policy. We’re committed to supporting your overall wellbeing and provide reimbursement for wellness initiatives that fit your lifestyle. Everyone counts: We are committed to creating a workplace where employees can participate fully, contribute meaningfully and succeed without barriers. We are dedicated to fostering a workplace defined by respect, fairness, and a true sense of belonging for everyone. We recognize and celebrate the unique experiences, identities, and perspectives that each of us bring – and that these experiences strengthen how we work together. Our commitment extends to ensuring that our application process is both inclusive and accessible. If you require accommodation to complete the application process, please contact us. Flexibility: All BDO personnel are expected to spend some of their time working in the office, at the client site, and virtually unless accommodations or alternative work arrangements are in place. Our model is a blended approach designed to support the flexible needs of our people, the firm and our clients. It’s about creating work experiences that meet everyone’s needs and providing flexibility to adjust when, where and how we work to meet the expectations of our role. Code of Conduct: Our Code of Conduct sets clear standards for how we conduct business. It reflects our shared values and commitments and includes guiding principles to help us make ethical decisions and maintain trust with each other, our clients, and the public. BDO may use artificial intelligence enabled tools to support certain aspects of the recruitment process. While these tools assist our teams, our use of AI does not replace human decision making, and all employment-related outcomes are made by BDO personnel. More information on BDO Canada’s Privacy Policy can be found here: Privacy Policy | BDO Canada Ready to make your mark at BDO? Click “Apply now” to send your up-to-date resume to one of our Talent Acquisition Specialists. To explore other opportunities at BDO, check out our careers page.

About the job 🚀Capitole Consulting keeps growing and we want to do it with you! We have an exciting opportunity to join an international team delivering business-critical solutions based on Microsoft's low-code ecosystem. We are looking for a Dynamics 365 / Microsoft Power Platform Developer with 4+ years of experience, a proactive professional with a strong technical background, excellent communication skills and the ability to quickly understand business needs, propose improvements and take ownership from day one. ✅ RESPONSABILITIES: Design, develop and maintain business solutions using Dynamics 365 and Microsoft Power Platform. Configure and optimize Power Automate, Power Apps and Dataverse solutions. Analyze business requirements and translate them into scalable technical solutions. Troubleshoot production issues, perform root cause analysis and implement sustainable improvements. Support integrations with external systems through APIs and data synchronization processes. Collaborate closely with business stakeholders to identify opportunities for process optimization and automation. Contribute to solution governance, documentation and continuous improvement initiatives. Participate in technical discussions, sharing ideas and proposing improvements to existing solutions. 🔍REQUIREMENTS: 4+ years of experience working with Dynamics 365 ( Costumer Service) and/or Microsoft Power Platform. Experiencia sólida con C#. Strong experience with Power Automate, Power Apps and Dataverse. Experience designing, developing and supporting business-critical applications. Knowledge of integrations using REST APIs, JSON and external services. Ability to troubleshoot complex issues and perform root cause analysis. Experience working in international environments and collaborating with cross-functional teams. Strong communication skills and the ability to quickly understand business processes. ✨ NICE TO HAVE: Experience with Power BI, SQL, Azure or Azure DevOps. Knowledge of corporate governance, compliance or internal control processes. Experience with solution architecture, ALM and Power Platform governance. Microsoft Power Platform or Dynamics certifications. ⚡SOFT SKILLS: Highly proactive and solution-oriented mindset. Ability to quickly onboard into new projects and technologies. Confidence to challenge existing approaches and propose new ideas. Strong ownership and accountability. Collaborative attitude and excellent stakeholder management skills. Continuous learning mindset and passion for innovation. 🗣️ English level: C1 🌍 German: Desirable 📍 100% remote within Spain (legal and physical residence in Spain required) 🕒 Working hours: Flexible, intensive schedule on Fridays. 🌟 We're great, but with you we'll be even better! What you'll get: 🎓 €1,200 annual training budget to invest in whatever helps you grow, including technology events, books, courses, certifications, and more. 💬 Monthly follow-ups with your team, ensuring continuous feedback and professional development. 🏠 Remote work. ⏰ Flexible working hours to help you maintain a healthy work-life balance. 🏥 Private health insurance, fully covered by Capitole. 💳 Flexible compensation package (meal vouchers, transportation, and/or childcare benefits). 💪 Wellhub (Gympass) membership to support your well-being. 🛍️ Exclusive employee discounts with leading brands through Club Capitole. Get to know the whole Capitole family: 🎉 Bi-monthly team-building events. Don't miss our Summer Party and Christmas Dinner! ⚽ Capitole-sponsored football team. 💡 Technology communities where you can share knowledge, experiences, and ideas with colleagues across different teams. Internal knowledge sharing is part of our DNA! 🚀 And last but not least... a fantastic TEAM! Don't know us yet? Discover us! 👉 https://capitole-consulting.com/ ⭐ See what our people say about us 🔗 https://www.glassdoor.es/Opiniones/Capitole-Consulting-Opiniones-E2060890.html Don't hesitate to send us your profile, we are looking forward to meeting you! The employee will adhere to information security policies: - Will have access to confidential information related to Capitole and the project they are working on. - Must comply with the security policies and internal policies of the company and the client. - Must sign an NDA.

Consultor/a Dynamics 365 CRM & Power Platform | Full Remote SPAIN | €35K - €40K
Joppy
Location: Spain · 20 hours ago · 15 people clicked apply Promoted by hirer · Responses managed off LinkedIn
About the job Una de las empresas con las que colaboramos in Joppy busca un/a Consultor/a Técnico/a Dynamics 365 CRM & Power Platform para unirse al equipo. Modalidad de trabajo: FULL REMOTE desde cualquier punto de España o HÍBRIDA en Madrid o Barcelona (1 día/semana en oficina). Buscamos un perfil diferencial con alma técnica y visión de negocio. Buscamos a un/a Consultor/a / Desarrollador/a Senior de Dynamics 365 CRM y Power Platform que entienda los requerimientos del cliente y sea capaz de traducirlos en soluciones técnicas robustas, abarcando desde las integraciones y automatizaciones hasta el diseño funcional de la solución. Si tienes una sólida base técnica en el ecosistema Microsoft y te motiva el contacto directo con el cliente y el desarrollo a medida, ¡este es tu lugar! ¿Cuál será tu impacto? Tu misión será conectar las necesidades del cliente con la ejecución técnica. Participarás activamente en el ciclo de los proyectos: desde la toma de requerimientos y comprensión del negocio hasta el diseño, desarrollo de integraciones, automatizaciones y configuración avanzada sobre la plataforma. ¿Qué harás en tu día a día? Análisis y Diseño Técnico-Funcional: Entender los procesos del cliente (en áreas como Marketing, Sales, Customer Service o Field Service) para diseñar y proponer la mejor solución técnica sobre Dynamics 365. Interlocución con Cliente: Actuar de puente entre el negocio y el equipo técnico, liderando sesiones de descubrimiento y definición de requerimientos. Desarrollo y Customización: Supervisar y ejecutar desarrollos a medida utilizando C# (plugins) y JavaScript (formularios), asegurando un óptimo rendimiento en Dataverse. Integraciones y Automatizaciones: Diseñar flujos de datos complejos y automatizaciones avanzadas utilizando Power Platform, Power Automate y herramientas de integración con sistemas externos. ¿Qué buscamos en ti? (Requisitos Imprescindibles) Experiencia en el ecosistema: Mínimo 4 años de experiencia real trabajando con Dynamics 365 CRM y Power Platform. Conocimiento de Módulos: Experiencia práctica en al menos un par de los siguientes módulos: Sales, Customer Service, Marketing o Field Service. Enfoque Técnico y de Desarrollo: Perfil híbrido (consultor/desarrollador) con experiencia en integraciones, automatizaciones y desarrollo sobre la plataforma (no buscamos un rol puramente de arquitectura, sino alguien con fuerte base técnica). Orientación al Cliente: Capacidad para entender necesidades de negocio y traducirlas en soluciones técnicas. Formación: Ingeniería Informática, Grado en Telecomunicaciones o Ciclo Formativo de Grado Superior en áreas IT. Inglés: Nivel técnico/intermedio (capacidad para desenvolverse en entornos y proyectos internacionales). ¿QUÉ OFRECEN? Un equipo diverso. Respetamos las diferencias que nos hacen más humanos. 💜 Compañerismo. Trabajamos en equipo y aprendemos los unos de los otros. Flexibilidad y conciliación. El teletrabajo está en nuestro ADN. Promovemos la flexibilidad horaria, y tenemos jornada intensiva los viernes y los meses de julio y agosto. 🙌 Aprendizaje continuo. Formaciones en idiomas, técnicas, certificaciones, etc. Carrera profesional individualizada, para que seas tú quien decide hasta dónde quieres llegar. 🚀 Autonomía y posibilidad de proponer y promover nuevas oportunidades. Programa de retribución flexible. Tickets guardería, restaurante, transporte, y seguro médico. Descuentos exclusivos y condiciones especiales en tecnología, ocio, viajes, etc. 🌟 Podrás formar parte de iniciativas solidarias y relacionadas con el medio ambiente. Si tienes inquietudes internacionales, estamos en 45 países. 🌍 ¡Únete a nuestro equipo y ayúdanos a humanizar el mundo a través de la tecnología!

Dynamics 365 CRM Solution Architect

About the job Role Overview We are looking for an experienced Dynamics 365 CRM Solution Architect to design and lead the implementation of enterprise-grade customer insight journeys and customer Marketing solutions within the Banking Sector. There is also inclusion of Dynamics 365 CCAAS. You will be responsible for defining the end-to-end CRM architecture using Dynamics 365 Customer insight journeys, ensuring scalability, security, regulatory compliance, and seamless customer experiences across all service channels. Key Responsibilities Solution Architecture & Design Define the overall CRM solution architecture for banking contact center programs Design scalable and secure architectures using Dynamics 365 CIJ/Marketing. Own the end-to-end solution design, including: Case management Customer interaction history Knowledge management Omnichannel routing and workload distribution Banking & Regulatory Alignment Ensure solutions comply with banking regulations and security standards, including: GDPR Data residency and data retention requirements Audit and traceability requirements Design role-based security models and data access controls in Dynamics 365 Collaborate with risk, compliance, and security teams Integration & Platform Architecture Define integrations with: Core banking systems Identity and access management platforms Telephony and enterprise CIJ solutions Architect solutions using: Power Platform Azure integration services APIs and event-driven architectures Leadership & Governance Act as the technical authority for CRM and CIJ architecture Review and approve functional and technical designs Guide development and configuration teams Support program governance, estimations, and roadmap definition
